dedupe_keys.name: coastal topo bathymetric dem of the harbor of saint malo and its surroundings

description: Shom publishes a coastal elevation model for Saint-Malo harbour and its surroundings, from the Décollé headland to Varde. The 0.00005-degree grid, approximately 5 m, combines topographic and bathymetric information for the local flood-prevention programme. Version 1 was published in 2020. Separate products use lowest astronomical tide or mean sea level as their vertical datum. ArcGIS Grid, BAG, GLZ and GRD formats are listed with open, free access under Etalab Open Licence 2.0 and source attribution. The model must not be used for navigation. Datum choices and heterogeneous survey sources limit direct combination with other terrain grids. The English metadata also names TANDEM whereas the French summary identifies PAPI Saint-Malo, an unresolved wording conflict. The grid can define nearshore geometry for coastal-flood and overtopping simulations affecting harbour assets and defences. It complements the wider 20 m gulf model and measured oceanographic series. Files were not downloaded.
